units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:54">Ib.</cite> O. XXII, 10 <he>למִיכַּס</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. <he>למֵיכַס</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:24">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>והאידנא נ׳ אבא וכ׳</he> and presently he will slaughter the father for the son and the son for the father (he will exercise extortions).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 5:3:6">Y. Shebi. V, end, 36ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיכּוֹס תורא וכ׳</he> to slaughter an ox available for the plough; a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 19:6">Targ. Lev. XIX, 6</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>אזל למִתְנַכְסָה וכ׳</he> was going to be slaughtered, and it lowed, as if to say, save me; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ <he>מִינְּכֵיס</he>; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ <he>מִנְּכִס</he> taken to be slaughtered.
